name: scroll-stack
title: Scroll Stack
description: A scroll view whose cards pin to the top and pile up, the ones beneath shrinking and dimming as more land.

perf.budget: One scroll offset drives a transform and an overlay per card on the UI thread; nothing renders while scrolling.

a11y.reducedMotion: Cards still pin and stack, which is how the layout reads, but without shrinking or dimming.
a11y.screenReader: A plain scroll view; cards are read in order and their content keeps its own roles.
a11y.touchTarget: Cards are full width and `cardHeight` tall.
